We asked ChatGPT to plan two days in Amsterdam. The day still went wrong.

It took 4 messages and 2,400 words of reading, for one person travelling alone.

Planning

“Settle into a bruin café, a traditional Dutch pub…”

I’m vegetarian and I don’t drink… Redo it.

Built for someone else. You fix it by typing.

On the street

A really narrow house… with a hook sticking out at the top. What is this?

“My guess… you might have seen Singel 7.”

It doesn’t know where you are, so it guesses.

When plans change

It’s 3pm, pouring rain… Fix the rest of today.

“…arriving at 4:30 may be too late.”

It can’t tell if you’ll get in. Then it sends a non-drinker into the red-light district after dark.
